rules_text.raw: You or the messenger may gain information from the dreamer you contact by asking questions as if using speak with dead to speak with a corpse. An unwilling dreamer can attempt to resist this probing with a Will save (as speak with dead , using the DC dream would have if it allowed a saving throw). Answers to these questions are still generally brief and cryptic.
